---
name: Research question or finding
about: Ask a feasibility question or share evidence relevant to the research plan.
---

# Research question or finding

This issue will be public. Use [private security reporting](https://github.com/lloydsmart/wii-netdisc/security/advisories/new)
for vulnerabilities and the [code of conduct](https://github.com/lloydsmart/wii-netdisc/blob/develop/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md#reporting-concerns)
for private conduct reports. Do not attach credentials, private information,
disc images, console dumps or the raw historical archive.

## Question or finding

What would you like to understand, or what have you found? Explain how it relates
to Wii NetDisc's feasibility. Link related issues or a
[research-plan item](https://github.com/lloydsmart/wii-netdisc/blob/develop/research/feasibility-plan.md)
where useful.

## Evidence and uncertainty

For a finding, include source links pinned to a commit, relevant files/functions,
or reproducible observations. Distinguish historical claims, hypotheses,
source-verified findings and experimentally verified results. State what remains
unknown. You do not need an answer or supporting evidence to ask a question.

## Suggested next step

If known, describe the research or check that could resolve the question.
Implementation, toolchain installation and hardware testing require a separately
approved task.
